run_protoc_main: run the protocol buffer compiler with a list of command line arguments via main()
compile_proto_files: compile .proto files to Python stubs by invoking protoc.py with protoc arguments
run_protoc_with_include: run protoc from the command line with the grpc_tools _proto include path auto-appended
invoke_protoc_compiler: invoke _protoc_compiler.run_main with encoded command arguments to compile protobuf definitions
resolve_proto_include_path: resolve the grpc_tools _proto resource directory path using pkg_resources.resource_filename
